verses.pali: “Sanidānā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no anidānā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with a source, not without a source.

verses.pali: Tasseva nidānassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that source, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
